subject: GCP listing kickoff + procurement workflow (Nimbus Analytics)
messages:
From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@nimbus.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: GCP marketplace listing & procurement path for Nimbus Analytics

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — Nimbus is excited about the performance gains we saw. Victor (cc'd) and I are ready to start the GCP Marketplace listing and the procurement workflow so our procurement team can purchase through the marketplace.

High-level asks from our side:
- Clear SKU and billing mapping (monthly usage vs SKU)
- DocuSign path for Commercial Terms and an expected timeline for PO/invoice issuance
- Any specific procurement questionnaire or evidence for security/compliance (SOC2, audit logs)

Can we pair your procurement/ops salesperson with our contracts owner next week to align on the handoff? We have internal approval budgeted for August.

Attached is our vendor questionnaire for your legal team to scan.

Best,
Alex
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: Nimbus_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Tan <alex.tan@nimbus.ai>, Victor Gomez <victor.gomez@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GCP marketplace listing & procurement path for Nimbus Analytics

Alex — thanks, excited to get this moving. Looping in procurement ops and billing: Karthik (sales ops) and Marissa (partner ops) will run the SKU mapping and the marketplace listing steps. Lauren from finance will own invoicing/PO requirements.

Quick plan proposal:
1) Karthik + Marissa to review your questionnaire and confirm GCP SKU mapping by EOD Thu (7/24).
2) We will produce a short procurement-runbook (how to buy via GCP marketplace, expected billing cadence, support SLAs).
3) Commercial terms: we can route via DocuSign once contracts@nimbus approves the SOW/terms; typical turnaround is 3-5 business days for standard terms.
4) Kickoff call: Wed 7/23 at 10am PT (30m) — agenda: SKU map, DocuSign owner, PO path, timeline to go-live.

If that works I'll send the calendar invite and a shared Drive folder.

—Kimberly
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Tan <alex.tan@nimbus.ai>, Victor Gomez <victor.gomez@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-22T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GCP marketplace listing & procurement path for Nimbus Analytics

Thanks Kimberly / Alex — quick checklist from our side (what we need to finalize the billing/procure flow):
- Your preferred billing model: monthly invoice or direct marketplace charge (we recommend marketplace SKU to simplify PO).
- Any reseller/managed service intermediary (looks like Nimbus will buy directly).
- Your finance contact for PO requirements (format, tax id, billing address).
- Confirmation whether you require Redwood to provide a separate invoice or use GCP Marketplace billing only.

I'll take the vendor questionnaire and convert answers into the procurement-runbook draft. We'll also produce a gcp-sku-mapping.csv showing how usage maps to marketplace SKUs and meter types. Expect initial draft by 7/24 EOD.

Karthik
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Victor Gomez <victor.gomez@nimbus.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Tan <alex.tan@nimbus.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2025-07-22T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GCP marketplace listing & procurement path for Nimbus Analytics

Karthik — thanks. Answers inline:
- Preferred billing: marketplace SKU charge (central finance prefers a single line item).
- No reseller — Nimbus will buy directly.
- Finance contact and PO template attached (see: finance_po_template.pdf in the folder).
- We would prefer Redwood to emit an invoice to Nimbus as a backup, but primary will be marketplace billing.

Also routing the vendor questionnaire to contracts@nimbus — they will confirm any security evidence requests. We have a DocuSign admin ready for signature once terms are drafted: Contracts lead is Sarah Lin (contracts@nimbus.ai).

Victor
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Nimbus Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Tan <alex.tan@nimbus.ai>, Victor Gomez <victor.gomez@nimbus.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-23T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GCP marketplace listing & procurement path for Nimbus Analytics

Alex/Victor — attaching the initial artifacts we discussed: gcp-sku-mapping.csv (maps our marketplace SKUs to the recommended Nimbus metering), and procurement-runbook-draft.pdf (runbook + expected billing handoffs).

Highlights:
- SKU mapping uses a single monthly subscription SKU plus metered usage for tokens processed; we included an example SOW line item.
- For a PO-first flow we recommend enabling invoice fallback: Redwood issues invoice if marketplace billing fails (common edge case).
- DocuSign flow: we typically send a DocuSign envelope to the contracts contact; we can include a short SOW + standard MSA addendum for Marketplace purchases.

Next steps: please confirm the PO template fields (tax ID, legal name, remit address). If OK, Karthik and I will finalize and request the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: gcp-sku-mapping.csv, procurement-runbook-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@nimbus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2025-07-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GCP marketplace listing & procurement path for Nimbus Analytics

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the artifacts — the SKU map looks good at a glance. Sarah in contracts has the vendor questionnaire and will route internally.

One quick ask: can Redwood include an example invoice and the marketplace SKU IDs in the DocuSign envelope? That will help our AP team match lines for the PO.

Let's keep the Wednesday 7/23 notes and move to signatures next week. I'll ask Sarah to share the DocuSign admin and expected signer.

Thanks again — Alex
